title: Tutorials: Learning-Oriented Guides in Documentation
summary: Diataxis tutorial principles: learning through guided practical activity, delivering visible results early, concrete focus, minimal explanation, and reliable execution.
when-to-read: Read when the task is to teach a skill through guided, hands-on practice rather than describe it. Do not read for instructions aimed at someone who already has the basic competence and just wants to accomplish a specific task (see how-to-guides), or for authoritative description of a system's parts (see reference-guides).
